source.title: Antithrombotic Agents in Coronary Artery Disease

consistency_findings: Table 7 contains at least one mortality row whose displayed therapy/control percentages and reported relative-risk-reduction direction are difficult to reconcile; those ambiguous Table 7 row values were not promoted into quantitative atoms.
The source is a review/consensus article; summarized trial results are tagged secondary_reported_result and do not imply that Cairns et al. enrolled the underlying trial participants.
schema_gaps: No dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind exists; recommendation atoms use atom_kind=other with guideline_recommendation tags, per the project secondary-source guardrail.
extraction_limitations: OCR introduces occasional character substitutions in the PDF text layer; numeric values used in atoms were cross-checked against rendered pages/tables when load-bearing.
Bibliography-only pages 478S-481S were excluded from atomization.
Not every citation-level result in this narrative review was atomized; extraction prioritizes source-level synthesis, recommendations, heparin-relevant evidence, and major tabulated results.
